eventDetail.scope: 2026 IEEE International Conference for Women in Computing (INCOWOCO 2026) is a global series sponsored by IEEE Education Society of IEEE Pune section and IEEE Pune section. The series starting in the year 2024, is to provide a common platform for researchers, especially women, from across the world to deliberate on broad understanding of computing concepts and its technical and business practices in the world of technological advancements. Women are paving their way and marking their presence in almost all tech fields. Since the beginning, women have carved a niche for themselves in the fields of Computers too. Be it the first computer programmer, compiler designer to application developers we have inspiring role models. Yet their achievements are very few when compared to male counterparts.
